# Framework blind double scoring

`customer_support.df.quality_assurance.framework_blind_double_scoring` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> Calibration by independent blind double-scoring, reconciled into a rubric edit rather than a reviewer instruction.

It is the only method that measures the programme's own accuracy. A programme that has never double-scored has no idea what its numbers mean and cannot know that.
